description:
AI teammates that use your tools, learn your workflows, and get real work done 24/7.

Grok Bot is an AI teammate built to get real work done. Give it a task and it can sign into your apps and websites, use your tools, and take projects from start to finish. Bots learn how you work, turn demonstrated workflows into reusable routines, retain context over time, and can collaborate with other Bots to handle work in parallel. Each Bot has its own computer, so it can keep working 24/7—even when your laptop is closed.
